steps.input:
program = '''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                    for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                        ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                        if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                            seen.add((ny, nx))
                            q.append((ny, nx))
            components.append((cells, color))
    cells, color = min(components, key=lambda item: len(item[0]))
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    chosen = set(cells)
    return [[color if (r, c) in chosen else 0 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
'''
file=base/'task-96b03c3d.py'
file.write_text(program)
print(file)

newprogram='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                    for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                        ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                        if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                            seen.add((ny, nx))
                            q.append((ny, nx))
            components.append((cells, color))
    eligible = []
    for cells, color in components:
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        left = sum((r, c0) in set(cells) for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))
        right = sum((r, c1) in set(cells) for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))
        if left == 1 or right == 1:
            eligible.append((cells, color))
    cells, color = max(eligible, key=lambda item: sum(r for r, c in item[0]) / len(item[0]))
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    chosen = set(cells)
    return [[color if (r, c) in chosen else 0 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
'''
